newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Capital One raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Capital One raised.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said it upgraded Capital One Financial Corp to near-term and long-term buy from near-term accumulate and long-term buy.
-- Additional details were not immediately available.
-- Capital One expects its second quarter earnings to be flat compared to last year's second quarter earnings of $0.57 a share, a spokeswoman for the company said Thursday.
-- On a consensus basis, analysts had expected Capital One to post second quarter earnings of $0.66 a share, according to First Call.
-- Capital One said deliquencies were flat, but charge offs were "as expected."
-- Capital One said it expects to release its second quarter earnings on or about July 17.
-- Capital One, which issues Visa and MasterCard credit cards in the United States, dropped 3-3/8 to 36-1/2.
